posts.title: PUBLISHER’S NOTE: PEACHES EN REGALIA
posts.description: It’s Nov. 3 and it’s a Tuesday and the sun is shining into our office. Ayden is playing “Peaches en Regalia” by Frank Zappa from the speakers of his MacBook and Vlad just walked into the office with a handful of tabloid proofs. The three of us are silent apart from the asynchronous click-clacking of our keyboards. October was a typical month at the Community Edition office in the way that the mundanity of our day-to-day operations was seasoned generously with a dash of the unplanned and a hint of the absurd. This newspaper is a wheel that turns at a constant pace and so when you introduce friction it can be tricky to coordinate your timing and strike between the spokes. One thing we have had on simmer for a while is our collaboration with The Walldog , which we’ve been coordinating with editor Shalaka Jadhav over the last few weeks ahead of our submission deadline. In short, we are cross publishing their second issue, which will also be live on their Substack by the time we go to print
